Data lineage

The dashboard consumes outputs from a contract-validated pipeline.

  1. Ingestion produces telemetry.v1.
  2. Lakehouse validates and materialises silver/gold layers.
  3. Intelligence publishes anomaly.v1.
  4. This dashboard remains read-only.

Explainable anomaly feed

This is a demonstrator for observability and review. It does not control equipment, acknowledge alarms or replace safety systems.
